an3.44:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi kathā pavattanī hoti?
an3.44:1.3: Yo dhammaṃ deseti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca,
an3.44:1.4: yo dhammaṃ suṇāti so atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca,
an3.44:1.5: yo c' eva dhammaṃ deseti yo ca dhammaṃ suṇāti ubho atthapaṭisaṃvedino ca honti dhammapaṭisaṃvedino ca.
an3.44:1.6: Imehi tīhi bhikkhave ṭhānehi kathā pavattanī hotī ti. 45. Tīṇ'
